item.title: New DHS Tool to Check Voters’ Citizenship Status Is Already a Mess
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security’s new tool to check voters’ citizenship is mistakenly identifying people as noncitizens, according to a report Friday from ProPublica and The Texas Tribune.
